text:
sec-bot: ALERT: High-volume export detected from analytics-db -> s3 (prefix: exports/2026-03-20/). 1.2 TB in 18m, principal=data-ingest-svc, method=COPY_TO_S3, kms_key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01

alex: seeing this, thanks. is this scheduled?

maria: not on the scheduled exports list. going to check runbook. tagging @samir for containment.

samir: cancel any active export jobs now. I will revoke the service principal token.

db-admin: running: 
```
-- identify active export session
SELECT pid, usename, query_start, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%COPY TO PROGRAM%';
```
Found pid=8421, user=data_ingest_role, application_name='data-exporter'

db-admin: killed pid 8421. confirmed no active COPY processes.

oncall-rotation: I revoked the short-lived token for data-ingest-svc in Vault and disabled its AWS role mapping.

jen: can we confirm S3 objects destination? need to preserve for forensic.

sec-bot: S3 objects at s3://redwood-internal-exports/exports/2026-03-20/; 3 objects: 400GB, 420GB, 380GB. Lifecycle shows PUT at 2026-03-20T13:02:12Z..13:20:01Z.

maria: leaving objects intact. creating a read-only snapshot and disabling further writes to that prefix (bucket policy applied).

alex: good. who initiated the job? check audit logs + orchestration.

samir: checking orchestration logs (k8s jobs + Airflow). found a job triggered by airflow DAG `daily_adhoc_exports` but triggered by a webhook from `analytics-ad-hoc-ui`. user agent=internal-webapp, actor=uid:svc-frontend-009.

maria: svc-frontend-009 normally doesn't have permission to invoke export. looks like a role escalation or UI bug. grabbing DB audit trail.

sec-bot: Audit logs (postgres) show GRANT executed last week: `GRANT data_exporter_role TO data_ingest_role;` by admin account `deploy-bot`.

alex: wait — `deploy-bot` shouldn't grant high-priv roles without an approval ticket. trace deploy-bot's action origin.

samir: deploy-bot action happened as part of PR #4827 auto-merge. that PR modified infra role bindings for `data_ingest_role` to include `data_exporter_role`. author=svc-ops.

jen: PR author svc-ops is a service account — why was an infra PR authored by a service account? need git history + CI signature.

db-admin: pulling DB audit rows: `SELECT * FROM audit.query_log WHERE user_role='data_ingest_role' AND ts > '2026-03-13';`

maria: I see a spike of similar adhoc exports on 2026-03-06 (small) and today's large one. both post-date the PR merge on 2026-03-12. correlation strong.

alex: immediate action items: (1) revert PR #4827 role binding change, (2) rotate KMS key used to encrypt exports, (3) restrict `data_exporter_role` to specific scopes, (4) open incident ticket + comms.

samir: already opened INC-2026 in PagerDuty and added initial timeline / evidence.

oncall-rotation: PR revert rolled back. applied RBAC change: removed data_exporter_role grant from data_ingest_role.

jen: KMS key rotation in progress: running `aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id abcd-ef01 --pending-window-in-days 7`? we should do rotation, not deletion. planning to create new key, rewrap objects.

maria: forensics note: do NOT delete the objects or rotate customer-facing keys. these are internal exports. will snapshot and copy to a forensics bucket encrypted under a new key.

db-admin: forensic copy completed to s3://forensics-redwood/INC-2026/; checksum verified.

sec-bot: external access checks: IAM CloudTrail shows no GetObject by external principals. only internal svc/ops roles performed GETs for verification.

alex: good. likely this was an internal misconfiguration (overbroad RBAC) rather than compromise, but we must assume risk until proven otherwise. next: narrow permissions and add policy guardrails to PRs.

samir: proposed mitigation PR: add CI check that prevents granting data_exporter_role to any non-human principal, and require an approval label `security-approved` for role changes. drafting now.

jen: also propose KMS access gating: only specific service principals can use export-key for Encrypt/Decrypt. adding to the PR.

maria: post-incident to-dos: 1) postmortem in 48h, 2) update runbook, 3) add alert rule for exports >100GB/day per principal, 4) increase audit log retention to 365d for role grants and IAM changes.

alex: assign owners: samir -> mitigation PR; jen -> KMS gating + key rotation plan; db-admin -> audit queries + retention; maria -> postmortem writeup and comms draft.

samir: FYI added branch `sec/INC-2026-guardrails`. small lint/CI tests failing but will push today.

maria: drafting comms for infra and affected product teams. keeping wording non-alarming: "temporary misconfiguration caused large internal export; data remained within company buckets; access keys rotated; controls added." will share for review.

sec-bot: NOTE: Monitoring rule created: export_volume_by_principal > 100GB/1h => pager.

alex: thanks team. keep updates here. once postmortem is ready, link to confluence page and mark incident resolved.

jen: quick question — should we rotate any service account credentials besides data-ingest-svc?

samir: yes, rotate any service accounts that got role grants in that PR: svc-ops, data-ingest-svc. I've scheduled a rotation window tonight 22:00 UTC.

db-admin: closing DB session audit window. will produce a compact CSV of suspicious queries and attach to INC-2026.

maria: attaching timeline draft to the incident. next update in 1h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: ack. great work."
